samples.user_input: What punishment is provided for qatl-i-amd under section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code?
samples.response: Section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code provides that the punishment for qatl-i-amd is death or life imprisonment, and the court may also impose a fine. [pakistan_law\pakistan_law.md#13]

samples.reference: Section 302 provides death as qisas; death or imprisonment for life as ta'zir when the required proof under Section 304 is unavailable; or imprisonment up to twenty-five years where qisas is not applicable under the Injunctions of Islam.

samples.user_input: According to Section 302, when can qatl-i-amd be punished with tazir instead of qisas, and what forms of proof are mentioned in the referenced Section 304?
samples.response: According to Section 302, qatl-i-amd can be punished with tazir instead of qisas when the proof in either of the forms specified in Section 304 is not available, or where according to the Injunctions of Islam the punishment of qisas is not applicable. The forms of proof mentioned in Section 304 are: (a) a voluntary and true confession by the accused before a court competent to try the offence, or (b) evidence as provided in Article 17 of the Qanune Shahadat, 1984.
